purpose: Reproach someone whose status should prevent their behavior.
keywords: High-status / responsible role + ともあろうものが
Someone in charge, of all people, concealed the records.
A teacher, of all people, mocked a student.
A doctor, of all people, failed to check.
formation: High-status / responsible role + ともあろうものが
restrictions: Conveys a strong unmet expectation tied to a role.
mistake: It is accusatory; do not use it for a neutral identity description.
